block.audio_merge_stream.name: Block name
block.audio_merge_stream.saved: Saved · used at the next Run
block.audio_merge_stream.save_error: Not saved. Stop the Run before changing settings; disconnect a source before removing it. {detail}
block.audio_merge_stream.source_hint: Connect both ports of each producer. Sources 1 and 2 are permanent; added sources can be removed once disconnected.
block.audio_merge_stream.run_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Stop, then Run to activate saved settings; these are not live volume controls.
block.audio_merge_stream.limits: Up to 16 simultaneous streams. Final-frame timeout is a safety limit, not a delay added to every stream.
block.audio_merge_stream.merge_help: Routes independent streams without changing their sound. Connect audio_out to both VAD and STT so their stream IDs match.
block.audio_merge_stream.mixer_help: Combines sources into one new Ogg/Opus stream. Stopping one source leaves the others playing. Mute/gain are applied at the next Run.
block.audio_merge_stream.merge_limit: Downstream limits still apply: the current VAD accepts at most four open streams. This block does not identify speakers or mix voices.
block.audio_merge_stream.mixer_limit: Arrival-aligned live mixing, not studio sample synchronization. Two seconds of decoded buffering per stream; a limiter prevents PCM overload. This is not echo cancellation.
block.audio_merge_stream.model.title: Audio Merge Stream
block.audio_merge_stream.model.descripti: Routes multiple Opus sources through one audio output while preserving independent stream lifecycles.
